title: UTA-wave 1.1.11 Playlist Resurrection Fix & Shuffle Overhaul
changelog:
• Fixed playlist resurrection bug: added persistent deleted_playlists tombstone table preventing sync & backup re-creation
• Bi-directional cloud deletion: deleting playlists locally automatically purges them remotely on YouTube Music
• Overhauled shuffle engine: replaced artist-biased algorithm with cryptographic Fisher-Yates high-entropy shuffle
• Smart opening track selection with recency history penalty preventing repeating opening songs
• Adjacent-artist relaxation swaps to prevent identical consecutive tracks without frequency bias
